summary: Initial independent chronology audit found six linked actionable defects. Two claims that explicitly span Guangqi 3 through Wende 1 flatten AD 887–888 into AD 887; the related active hints repeat that loss. A separate 光啟前後 entry and its hint assert unsupported point-year precision. The canonical extraction is unchanged pending a date-only repair and a fresh independent audit.

itemChecks.event: Chronology of Yang Xingmi’s referenced activity.
itemChecks.reason: The supplied source-date span explicitly runs from Guangqi 3 through Wende 1, but the stored western value is only AD 887. Guangqi 3 is AD 887 and Wende 1 is AD 888, so a point year loses the stated endpoint.
